data.title: Garrett Jin Whale Becomes Largest Native Zcash Short Holder as ZEC Rallies Above $1,200
data.description:
On-chain analyst Yu Jin said the Garrett Jin whale entity (0x92ea...050e9) is the largest holder of native Zcash short positions. According to Odaily, the entity opened a short position on 32,760 ZEC in early July at $444, and the position is now down $25.7 million after ZEC rose from $400 to above $1,200 over the past three months.

The entity also holds a Bitcoin long position worth $107 million, which is up $4.42 million, but it has paid $2.05 million in funding fees.

data.title: Altcoin Open Interest Share Tops Bitcoin for First Time in Over a Year
data.description: Coinalyze data show that altcoin open interest has surpassed Bitcoin's share for the first time in more than a year. According to Odaily, this marks the first such occurrence in over a year.

data.title: Altcoin Open Interest Share Tops Bitcoin for First Time in Over a Year
data.description: Altcoin open interest has surpassed Bitcoin's share for the first time in more than a year, according to Coinalyze data. According to ChainCatcher, the shift reflects a change in derivatives positioning across the crypto market.

data.title: TSMC Adds More 3-Nanometer Capacity as AI Demand Rises
data.description:
TSMC is adding more capacity for advanced processes below 3 nanometers at customers' request as demand rises for AI and high-performance computing applications. According to ChainCatcher, market participants expect 3-nanometer output to surpass 5-nanometer output for the first time in the second half of the year.

They also estimate that TSMC's third-quarter output value will exceed 400 billion yuan for the first time, reach a record high, account for more than 30% of revenue, and support gross margin performance.

data.title: STOCKS | HKEX Lists Top Southbound Turnover Stocks On Friday
data.description:
Hong Kong Exchanges and Clearing (00388) said the top 10 most actively traded stocks in Southbound Stock Connect on Friday, July 4, included MiniMax (00100), SMIC (00981), Zhipu (02513), Kingboard Laminates (01888), Hua Hong Semiconductor (01347), Tencent (00700), Akeso (09926), Alibaba (09988), Genscript Biotech (01548) and Yangtze Optical Fibre and Cable (06869), according to ETNet.

In the Shanghai-bound channel, MiniMax recorded HK$2.304 billion in buys and HK$2.022 billion in sells for a net inflow of HK$281.79 million. Kingboard Laminates posted a net inflow of HK$502.25 million, while Zhipu saw HK$481.45 million. Tencent had the largest net outflow at HK$620.50 million, followed by SMIC at HK$795 million.

In the Shenzhen-bound channel, Tencent again led turnover with HK$481.01 million in buys and HK$1.962 billion in sells for a net outflow of HK$1.481 billion. MiniMax topped net inflows at HK$665.84 million, while Alibaba recorded HK$207.63 million. Xiaomi (01810) also appeared in the Shenzhen-bound top 10 with a net outflow of HK$745.62 million.

data.title: Fund Holdings Changes Show JPMorgan, Morgan Stanley, and Others Adjust Stakes in Listed Companies
data.description:
Fund filings showed a series of changes in holdings across Hong Kong-listed companies, according to ETNet.

JPMorgan increased its stake in Kingdee International, China Southern Airlines, Xinyi Solar, and Hesai, while trimming positions in Cathay Pacific, Jiangxi Copper, CRRC, Meituan, CICC, and Lens Technology. Morgan Stanley raised its holding in Pony AI. Other disclosed moves included Brandes Investment increasing its stake in First Pacific, Oaktree Capital cutting its holding in LEAD Intelligent, and Temasek reducing its position in Sino Biopharmaceutical.

The filings also showed changes by UBS Group, E Fund Management, Sun Life Financial, Invesco, and China International Capital Corporation across names including Hesai, BeOne Medicines, Tigermed, CNOOC Oilfield Services, and Pony AI.

data.title: Japan's August Foreign Exchange Reserves Fall to $1.2075 Trillion
data.description: According to Jin10, Japan's foreign exchange reserves stood at $1.2075 trillion in August, down from $1.2871 trillion previously.

data.title: China to Expand Personal Pension Fund List With Equity-Linked Bond Funds
data.description: China is set to further expand its personal pension fund lineup by adding eligible equity-linked secondary bond funds and balanced bond-heavy mixed funds to the product list, according to Jiemian News. Several fund companies have received a notice from regulators titled "Notice on Doing a Good Job in Including Equity-Linked Secondary Bond Funds and Balanced Bond-Heavy Mixed Funds in the Personal Pension Fund Product List," and will soon promote the inclusion of products that meet certain conditions. The funds are generally classified by the market as broad fixed-income-plus products, using fixed-income assets as a base while adding stocks, convertible bonds and equity-oriented funds to enhance returns.

data.title: STOCKS | Goldman Strategist Sees 80% Upside for South Korean Shares
data.description: A Goldman Sachs Group Inc. strategist is sticking with an 80% upside target for South Korean stocks, saying investors are underestimating how long the AI boost for the country’s memory chipmakers will last, according to Bloomberg.

data.title: STOCKS | Bear Robotics Seeks Pre-IPO Funding Ahead of Nasdaq Listing
data.description: According to Sina Finance, citing the Korea Economic Daily and unnamed investment banking sources, LG Electronics-backed U.S. robotics startup Bear Robotics is preparing for a Nasdaq listing and is conducting pre-IPO financing. Bear Robotics has selected Bank of America as the financing arranger and is in talks with private equity firms in South Korea and overseas to participate in the round. The company is targeting a valuation of about 2 trillion won and plans to raise 300 billion to 400 billion won, with the funds to be used for robotics research and development.

data.title: Huawei, Apple, and Xiaomi Set for 72-Hour Foldable Phone Showdown
data.description: According to Jin10, Huawei, Xiaomi, and Apple will sequentially launch their foldable flagship phones within 72 hours from the afternoon of September 7 to the early hours of September 10. Huawei and Apple will face off directly in the foldable phone segment for the first time, with Xiaomi joining the competition, marking the first time the three brands have clashed in the same week, category, and price range since the foldable segment emerged seven years ago.

data.title: STOCKS | Goldman Sachs Says Tactical Long Yen Case Has Strengthened
data.description:
Goldman Sachs said the case for tactically going long the yen has strengthened after the currency's recent gains. According to Sina Finance, the bank cited expectations that the Bank of Japan will tighten monetary policy, possible changes in Japanese capital flows, and the risk of further intervention.

The strategists, including Kamakshya Trivedi, wrote that the asymmetry has improved over a longer horizon, making short dollar/yen an increasingly attractive hedge for risk-seeking portfolios. Goldman Sachs also said Bank of Japan Governor Kazuo Ueda had essentially confirmed market expectations for a September rate hike, while speculation that the Government Pension Investment Fund may shift allocations toward domestic assets has increased the outlook for reduced capital outflows.

The bank said the global backdrop still weighs on the yen and should continue to do so absent growth concerns, but supportive domestic policy shifts should now have a greater impact after previously being a major source of downward pressure. It added that Japanese policymakers appear committed to using existing tools to attract capital inflows while retaining ample room for further intervention.

data.title: SideSwap Suspends Liquid Services After Invalid L-BTC Minting Incident
data.description:
SideSwap said a customer sent 4,000 L-BTC to its peg-out service at 14:05 UTC, and the order was processed normally. According to ChainCatcher, the L-BTC was burned on Liquid with a valid peg-out authorization, and the Liquid Federation later paid 3,996 BTC to the customer’s Bitcoin address at 14:28 UTC.

Blockstream later confirmed that the L-BTC had been minted through an Elements software vulnerability. SideSwap said its peg-out authorization key and systems were not compromised, and the service could not distinguish the tokens from other L-BTC. SideSwap added that it is a non-custodial service, user wallets were not affected, and assets remain controlled by users’ own keys.

Liquid has been suspended by the Federation, and SideSwap said swaps, peg-ins, and peg-outs will remain paused until the network is restored. Completed peg-outs paid on Bitcoin are not affected. Users with unfinished peg-ins or peg-outs can send transaction IDs to hello@sideswap.io for separate handling, and SideSwap asked users not to send new peg-in or peg-out deposits before services resume.

data.title: Go Inc. Says Ride Volume Holds Up After Fare Hikes
data.description:

The company pulled off Japan’s biggest initial public offering this year.

data.description: Australian retirement village operator Ingenia Communities rejected a A$1.9 billion ($1.4 billion) takeover bid from Warburg Pincus, according to Bloomberg.

data.title: UK Recruitment Activity Accelerates for First Time in Four Years, Survey Shows
data.description:
A survey closely watched by Bank of England policymakers showed that British companies increased full-time hiring in August. According to Sina Finance, the Recruitment and Employment Confederation said its index tracking permanent job placements rose for the first time since September 2022.

Recruiters said the data reflected improving business optimism, with companies winning new orders and taking on more work. KPMG UK Chief Executive Jon Holt said the rebound in permanent hiring in August, alongside growth in temporary hiring, meant market confidence was starting to return.

The survey also added to evidence that the UK labor market remains resilient in the face of global energy shocks and high interest rates, ahead of the Bank of England's next rate decision on September 17. Policymakers are currently voting to keep rates unchanged while weighing the risk that renewed conflict in the Middle East could push up inflation against signs of economic weakness.

data.title: STOCKS | Trump Posts 27 Images and Claims on Sunday, Including AI-Generated Content
data.description: According to Jin10, U.S. President Donald Trump posted 27 times from around noon to 4 p.m. Eastern Time on Sunday, including multiple AI-generated images and claims about Iran, Democrats, renaming places, and self-praise.
